data.name: _build_entrapment_fasta
data.value: Build the peptide FASTA a library is predicted from: the digest of the proteins of --db, with decoys and, with --entrapment, entrapment peptides; the pairing manifest goes to --manifest.

data.name: _reconcile_manifest
data.value: Write the pairing manifest of --manifest reconciled against the predicted library of --predicted-library, dropping the pairs the library did not keep whole.

data.name: _manifest
data.value: The pairing manifest: written by --build-entrapment-fasta, read by --reconcile-manifest.

data.name: _predicted_library
data.value: The predicted library (a TSV, or a .blib) a manifest is reconciled against.

data.name: _model_info
data.value: Describe a saved model (.model.zip, a ZIP archive): what it was trained on, and how.

data.name: _db
data.value: The FASTA to predict a library from (peptides, as --build-entrapment-fasta writes them, or proteins), or the proteins --build-entrapment-fasta digests. With training (--i), the library predicted with the fine-tuned models afterwards.

data.name: _i
data.value: Osprey's results to train on: its .blib with --ms, or its training exports (one run's .training.parquet, a comma-separated list of them, or a folder of them) with or without --ms. With a .blib and no --ms a library is predicted instead, as in Carafe.

data.name: _ms
data.value: The runs trained on, comma-separated. CarafeSharp reads no spectra: the fragment matches, XICs and peak boundaries come from Osprey's training export, so --ms only names the runs.

data.name: _o
data.value: The output folder: the library, and for training the fine-tuned model folder and the saved .model.zip.

data.name: _help
data.value: Print this usage and exit. An optional value picks the form: ascii or unicode (the default) tables, sections (the section names only), html, or a section name for that section alone.

data.name: _enzyme
data.value: The enzyme, by its index or name in the ENZYMES list below (default 1, Trypsin). Index 0, non-specific, cleaves after every residue and forces 100 missed cleavages; NoCut, the last, never cleaves, so each FASTA record is one peptide.

data.name: _miss_c
data.value: Maximum missed cleavages (default 2).

data.name: _min_length
data.value: Minimum peptide length (default 7).

data.name: _max_length
data.value: Maximum peptide length (default 35).

data.name: _clip_n_m
data.value: Also digest each protein with its N-terminal methionine removed.

data.name: _fix_mod
data.value: Fixed modifications, by their ids in the MODIFICATIONS list below, comma-separated (default 1, Carbamidomethyl of C).

data.name: _var_mod
data.value: Variable modifications, by their ids in the MODIFICATIONS list below, comma-separated (default 2, Oxidation of M).

data.name: _max_var
data.value: Maximum variable modifications per peptide (default 1).

data.name: _min_pep_mz
data.value: Minimum precursor m/z (default 300).

data.name: _max_pep_mz
data.value: Maximum precursor m/z (default 2000).

data.name: _min_pep_charge
data.value: Minimum precursor charge (default 2).

data.name: _max_pep_charge
data.value: Maximum precursor charge (default 3 for the FASTA build, 4 for library prediction).

data.name: _i2l
data.value: Convert isoleucine to leucine in every sequence.

data.name: _entrapment
data.value: Add entrapment peptides, shuffled from the targets, or taken from the proteins of --entrapment-db.

data.name: _no_decoys
data.value: Write no decoy peptides.

data.name: _decoy_prefix
data.value: The prefix of decoy protein names (default decoy_ for the FASTA build, rev_ for a library).

data.name: _mz_filter
data.value: Keep only the peptides with a precursor m/z inside --min-pep-mz to --max-pep-mz at some charge of --min-pep-charge to --max-pep-charge, modifications counted.

data.name: _entrapment_seed
data.value: The seed of the entrapment shuffle (default 42).

data.name: _decoy_seed
data.value: The seed of the decoy generation (default 24).

data.name: _entrapment_db
data.value: A FASTA of a foreign species whose peptides are the entrapment, in place of shuffled targets.

data.name: _entrapment_ratio
data.value: Entrapment peptides per target, 0.1 to 1.0 (default 1.0).

data.name: _no_similarity_gate
data.value: Keep the entrapment peptides that are near-copies of their own targets. For audit comparison only: the resulting library should not be searched.

data.name: _ignore_pairing_errors
data.value: Write the pairing manifest even when it fails its integrity checks.

data.name: _lf_type
data.value: The library format, comma-separated for more than one: DIA-NN (default), EncyclopeDIA or Skyline, a TSV in that notation, or blib, a BiblioSpec library. Skyline with --fast writes a .blib too.

data.name: _fast
data.value: With --lf-type Skyline, write the library as a .blib; without --fast Carafe writes a generic TSV.

data.name: _lf_frag_mz_min
data.value: Minimum fragment m/z (default 200).

data.name: _lf_frag_mz_max
data.value: Maximum fragment m/z (default 1800).

data.name: _lf_top_n_frag
data.value: Fragments kept per precursor, the most intense first (default 20).

data.name: _lf_min_n_frag
data.value: Minimum fragments for a precursor to be written (default 2).

data.name: _lf_frag_n_min
data.value: Lowest fragment ordinal kept, b and y alike (default 2).

data.name: _nce
data.value: The normalized collision energy the MS2 model predicts at (default 27, or a model folder's).

data.name: _ms_instrument
data.value: The instrument the MS2 model predicts for, by AlphaPeptDeep's name (default Eclipse, or a model folder's).

data.name: _activation
data.value: The activation predicted for, else a training run's. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _analyzer
data.value: The MS2 analyzer predicted for, else a training run's. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _rt_max
data.value: The gradient length the library's retention times are scaled to, in minutes; absent, iRT.

data.name: _ccs
data.value: Predict ion mobility (1/K0) for timsTOF.

data.name: _pairing_manifest
data.value: The pairing manifest of --build-entrapment-fasta: the library then carries Carafe's DecoyPairs table, every pair written whole or not at all.

data.name: _library_contract
data.value: Check the library against the Osprey library contract (one row per precursor, clean accessions, decoys and entrapment marked, the manifest authoritative, pairs whole) before predicting and after writing, refuse or discard it on a violation, and mark the .blib as meeting the contract so Osprey checks it at load instead of repairing it. Needs --lf-type blib and --pairing-manifest, and a FASTA built without Carafe's per-peptide accession suffix.

data.name: _rt_reference
data.value: With a model trained with --rt-align kde, the training run whose minutes the library takes; else the model's, and iRT for a model of runs on different gradients. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _model_dir
data.value: A Carafe fine-tuned model folder to predict with: its MS2 and RT models (those --tf names), metrics and training-run summary.

data.name: _model
data.value: A saved model (.model.zip, a ZIP archive), which every training run writes into --o: predict a library with it, or with --i fine-tune it further. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _pretrained
data.value: The AlphaPeptDeep pretrained models zip (default: the one beside the executable). Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _tf
data.value: The models to train: all (default), ms2 or rt.

data.name: _rt_model
data.value: The retention-time model (default: the one of a saved model or model folder, else chronologer). A different one from a fine-tuned model's predicts with its pretrained model, Chronologer's in iRT. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _device
data.value: Where the models run: cpu, or gpu / cuda (default; the CPU when there is no CUDA device).

data.name: _ms2_model
data.value: The MS2 model (a PyTorch checkpoint) fine-tuning starts from, in place of the pretrained one.

data.name: _se
data.value: The search engine of --i: only Osprey, whose training export CarafeSharp trains on.

data.name: _fdr
data.value: The q-value cutoff of the precursors trained on (default 0.01).

data.name: _cor
data.value: The minimum fragment correlation of a precursor trained on (default 0.75).

data.name: _n_ion_min
data.value: The lowest b-ion ordinal trained on (default 0, every ordinal).

data.name: _c_ion_min
data.value: The lowest y-ion ordinal trained on (default 0, every ordinal).

data.name: _nf
data.value: The minimum matched fragments of a precursor trained on (default 4).

data.name: _min_n
data.value: The minimum valid fragments of a precursor trained on (default 4).

data.name: _valid
data.value: Require a precursor's most intense fragment to be valid.

data.name: _no_masking
data.value: Train on every ion of the kept spectra, masking none.

data.name: _seed
data.value: The random seed of training (default 2024; not negative).

data.name: _rt_align
data.value: How the training runs' retention times are aligned before the RT model is fine-tuned: kde (default; each run's minutes mapped onto Chronologer's hydrophobic index by a KDE ridge on 1000 peptide forms or more, else a LOESS or a line; runs on one gradient train a model of their aligned minutes, runs on different gradients a Chronologer of the index) or none (Carafe's one rt_max). Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _rt_select
data.value: With aligned runs, the retention time a peptide form trains on: its best run, or the runs' median. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _log_file
data.value: Write every line of output and error to this file instead of the console. Not in Java Carafe; any mode.

data.name: _timestamp
data.value: Prefix each line with the time. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _memstamp
data.value: Prefix each line with the managed and private memory in use. Not in Java Carafe.

data.name: _itol
data.value: Carafe's XIC extraction settings (--itol, --itolu, --sg, --min-mz, --rf, --rf-rt-win, --rt-win-offset) are Osprey's to decide: the matches, XICs and peak boundaries come from its training export, so each is reported and ignored.

data.name: _itolu
data.value: See --itol.

data.name: _sg
data.value: See --itol.

data.name: _min_mz
data.value: See --itol.

data.name: _rf
data.value: See --itol.

data.name: _rf_rt_win
data.value: See --itol.

data.name: _rt_win_offset
data.value: See --itol.

data.name: _na
data.value: Flanking spectra; only 0 is supported.

data.name: _mode
data.value: Carafe's mode; only general is supported.

data.name: _ai_version
data.value: Carafe's Python version; only v2 is ported.

data.name: _lf_format
data.value: Carafe's library file format; parquet is not supported.

data.name: _ez
data.value: A Carafe diagnostic file (--ez, --xic, --export-mgf, --skyline) CarafeSharp does not write; reported and ignored.

data.name: _xic
data.value: See --ez.

data.name: _export_mgf
data.value: See --ez.

data.name: _skyline
data.value: See --ez.

data.name: _print_ptm
data.value: Not supported by CarafeSharp.

data.name: _build_koina_library
data.value: Not supported by CarafeSharp, which has no Koina client.

data.name: _mod2mass
data.value: Not supported by CarafeSharp.

data.name: _user_var_mods
data.value: Not supported by CarafeSharp.

data.name: _cs
data.value: Not supported by CarafeSharp training.

data.name: _use_all_peaks
data.value: Not supported by CarafeSharp training.

data.name: _y1
data.value: Not supported by CarafeSharp training.
